name.description: The domain name for which this record is valid

data.description:
The target address dns name resolves to.
This could be ip address, canonical name, nae server etc.

ttl.description:
The TTL is a value in a DNS record that determines the number of seconds
before subsequent changes to the record go into effect

priority.description:
the priority of the target host, lower value means more preferred.
The priority can be any number 0 and 65535
This field is used by SRV Records.

service.description:
The name that refers to the desired service.
This field is used by SRV Records.

protocol.description:
The protocol of the desired service; this is usually either TCP or UDP.
This field is used by SRV Records.

port.description:
The TCP or UDP port on which the service is to be found.
The port can be any number 0 and 65535,
This field is used by SRV Records.

weight.description:
A relative weight for records with the same priority. Determines which of the records with the
same priority are delivered more frequently. Enter the proportional volume of traffic as a percent.
This field is used by SRV Records.

title: This type represents a Dns record in GoDaddy domain.
name: GoDaddyDnsRecord
